svg.text: Performed experimental precedent for generated complete reactions
Selected cases; complete net chemistry, not experimentally established electron-arrow sequences.
4-Hydroxybenzoic acid 11.04 g, thionyl chloride 80 mL and DMF 0.1 mL, reflux 2 h; evaporation and toluene coevaporation.
Residue containing the named acid chloride was carried into the subsequent amidation.
3,5-Difluorobenzoic acid (source reports 1.63 g, 10.00 mmol), thionyl chloride 20 mL, boiling 2 h; evaporate to dryness
and coevaporate twice with toluene. Source reports 1.45 g, 82% of theoretical, as crude product used in Step 2.
o-Cresol 21.6 g/0.2 mol in aqueous NaOH (12 g/0.3 mol, water 100 mL), ice 300 g; acetic anhydride 30.6 g/0.3 mol, shake
1 min. Ether extraction and reduced-pressure distillation give 25 g, 83.3%; boiling point 66 C/1 mmHg.
Source/training overlap unknown; an experimentally documented transformation is not a tested whole route.
